hebrew:

וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלזוּ וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִילוּ.
translation: And thus the righteous will see and rejoice, the upright will be glad, and the pious will exult with song. (ChatGPT translation)
